ModMetaData.name: Jarimichus Lasers
ModMetaData.author: Jarimichu
ModMetaData.description:
Lasers for RimWorld: wireless power over laser beams, a mining laser, a laser cannon, and a control console to crew them. Every part can be switched off in the mod settings.
Beamwire: wireless power Build a beam emitter on one grid and a beam receiver on another, and the power flows between them through the air. Bend beams with mirrors in 8 directions, split them with splitters and prisms, carry them across the map with relays, store them in capacitors, and guard them with safety shutters. The network aims itself as you build. Beams power the lasers too.
Mining laser A three-barrelled turret that cuts rock marked for mining in sight at any angle, for full yield: about a good miner's speed at 1,500 W.
Laser cannon A twin-barrelled defence turret with continuous red beams: 18 DPS, 27 when manned. It holds fire while a friendly is in the line of fire.
Laser control console A military fire-control station with a wraparound cockpit-style display. Link up to 3 lasers and one colonist mans them all: cannons hit harder and reach further, mining lasers cut faster and let you choose their rock.
Also - Optional Odyssey support: gravship hull-mounted looks, bonuses in vacuum, and no dust on optics in vacuum. - A clean high-tech look: white ceramic and teal light, with teal power beams. - Research tied into vanilla progression. Beamwire has its own tab; the lasers sit on the Main tab. - Compatible with Vanilla Expanded power mods and Combat Extended.
